numbered-cards.looks: A centred title and subtitle, then dark navy cards numbered automatically (1, 2, 3 ...), each with a bold title and a short paragraph; shown as a grid or a carousel.
numbered-cards.use: Ordered steps or tips, e.g. 'What To Do' after sextortion.

fields.cardTitle: A short instruction, e.g. 'Don't pay or comply.' Do not type the number; it is added.
